kitEvidence.formula: Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing [50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and Slowing them by [25]% for [2.5] seconds. Enemies in the center take [(50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.65) × AP) × (1.667)] magic damage instead and are Slowed by [(0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × 100]%, decaying over [2.5] seconds.
